steps.en: Officer opens a page listing vehicle registration types
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman daftar tipe registrasi kendaraan
steps.why_en: No page is dedicated to vehicle types; officers use a generic code-maintenance page instead.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada halaman khusus tipe kendaraan; officer memakai halaman pemeliharaan kode yang generik.

steps.en: Officer adds a new vehicle registration type
steps.id: Officer menambah tipe registrasi kendaraan baru

steps.en: Officer edits a type description or marks it inactive
steps.id: Officer mengubah deskripsi tipe atau menandainya tidak aktif

steps.en: The change appears in the vehicle type choices on staff screens
steps.id: Perubahan muncul di pilihan tipe kendaraan di layar staff

steps.en: Notice handling for local and foreign vehicles follows the configured types
steps.id: Penanganan notice kendaraan lokal dan asing mengikuti tipe yang dikonfigurasi
steps.why_en: Local and foreign rules are fixed in the program; configuration only changes the list of choices.
steps.why_id: Aturan lokal dan asing tertanam di program; konfigurasi hanya mengubah daftar pilihan.
